rationale: N-Dynamic provides native pod routing without encapsulation and uses per-node BGP peering with Cloud Router, allowing on-premises systems to reach pod IPs directly. It best matches the network team’s requirement to own routing control and prioritizes performance over the operational and infrastructure cost of maintaining many BGP sessions.

N-Dynamic provides non-encapsulated pod reachability through per-node BGP advertisements, allowing on-premises systems to access pod IPs directly and letting the network team retain routing-control ownership. It also avoids overlay overhead and scales better operationally than managing large sets of static VPC routes for a 200-node, performance-sensitive cluster.

It is better suited than static route updates for a 200-node, highly dynamic Spot fleet, while avoiding the platform mismatch of GKE alias-IP routing.
